resources.string: Rempart helps you break free from pornography by blocking adult websites and overly revealing images on this phone, in every browser and inside apps.\n\nRempart is free, open source, with no ads and no purchases. It collects no data: everything happens on your phone.
I am installing Rempart for myself, on my own phone, of my own free will.
Rempart must never be installed without someone\'s knowledge. It has no hidden mode and no remote monitoring.
Turn on each protection. You can lock everything afterwards.
A local VPN filters adult website addresses and enforces safe search (Google, Bing, YouTube, DuckDuckGo). No traffic is sent to any Rempart server.
Closes adult pages even in private browsing and in browsers built into apps (Xender, Vidmate…), and protects Rempart\'s settings once it is locked.
Android will refuse to uninstall Rempart until you unlock it.
To warn you if a protection is switched off.
In Settings › Network › VPN › Rempart (gear icon), turn on \"Always-on VPN\" and \"Block connections without VPN\". Then no website opens if the filter is stopped.

Rempart uses Android's Accessibility API to:

• read the address and text of pages shown in browsers and apps, in order to close adult content;
• once you have locked it, stop you from opening the settings that would disable or uninstall it.

This information is analysed on the phone and immediately forgotten. Nothing is stored, nothing is sent.

On the next screen, choose "Rempart" and turn it on.
Choose someone you trust (friend, spouse, mentor, counsellor). Only they will know the code that unlocks Rempart immediately. Without it, you will have to wait for the delay.
My partner types the code themselves (recommended)
Generate a code and send it to them
Hand the phone to your partner so they can type their code without you seeing it.
Send this code to your partner, then delete the message on your side. Rempart only keeps an encrypted fingerprint of it.
Hi, I chose you as my trusted partner in Rempart. Keep this code to yourself: %1$s. Only give it to me if you are sure it is a good idea.
Waiting period to unlock without a partner: %1$d h
The code must contain at least 8 letters or digits.
This code is too simple. Mix more characters.

Once locked, you will no longer be able to disable or uninstall Rempart, except with your partner\'s code or after a %1$d h request (which you can cancel).\n\nNo app can be made completely impossible to remove: a factory reset always erases everything.
Before locking, turn on every protection.
A relapse does not erase your progress
The counter restarts from zero, your record is kept. What triggered the urge? Noting it helps you protect yourself better next time.
I have an urge, help me
The lock is open: you can disable or uninstall Rempart.
Wrong code. %1$d attempts left before a pause.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Without a partner: request with a delay
Your request will be carried out after %1$d h of the phone being on. Changing the clock does not speed it up. You can cancel at any time, and that is often the best decision.
Cancel the request and stay protected
Rempart is locked. To disable it, use your partner\'s code or start an unlock request in the app.

string-array.name: encouragements
string-array.item: This moment will pass. An urge rises, peaks, then fades, often in less than 15 minutes.
You installed Rempart for a good reason. That reason is still true right now.
Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4, breathe out for 6. Repeat three times.
Stand up, drink a glass of water, change rooms. A moving body calms the mind.
Every refusal strengthens the brain you want to have. You just won one.
Tired, lonely, stressed, bored? These are signals, not orders. What do you really need?
Call or text someone, even about something else. Isolation feeds the urge.
A relapse does not erase your journey. What matters is what you do now.

resources.string: You do not have to get through this alone. Talking to a health professional (doctor, psychologist, addiction specialist) is a real strength.
If you have suicidal thoughts, call your country\'s emergency number right away. In France: 3114 (suicide prevention, 24/7, free).

• SOS Amitié (France): 09 72 39 40 50, listening 24/7
• Fil Santé Jeunes (France, ages 12-25): 0 800 235 236, free and anonymous
• A general practitioner can refer you to an addiction clinic
• Peer support groups exist in many countries (online and in person)

• Spot your triggers (tiredness, loneliness, stress, boredom, late evenings)
• Do not keep your phone in bed at night
• Exercise, go out, see people
• Replace the habit with another activity prepared in advance
• Be honest with your trusted partner
This log shows protection events (never the sites visited). Your partner can review it with you.
Network filter switched off (other VPN or disabled)
Attempt to remove the device administrator
Protection interrupted (phone off, safe mode or force stop)
Rempart is locked: settings cannot be relaxed.
Rempart follows the phone\'s language. On Android 13 and later, you can pick a different one for Rempart only.
The strongest option: it also blocks safe mode, adding users and switching VPNs. It is enabled from a computer (ADB) on a phone with no account. See docs/DEVICE_OWNER.md.

Rempart is free software (GPL-3.0 licence), free of charge, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Privacy: Rempart does not collect, store or transmit any personal data. Displayed pages are analysed on the phone and immediately forgotten. Only counters (items blocked, days without relapse) and the integrity log are kept, on the phone only.

Network: allowed DNS requests are forwarded to the chosen filtering resolver (Cloudflare for Families by default). Blocklists are downloaded from GitHub once a week over Wi-Fi.

Lists: HaGeZi (GPL-3.0), StevenBlack hosts (MIT).
